sections.heading: About Bancrédito International Bank & Trust Corp.
items: Bancrédito International Bank & Trust Corp. was a San Juan, Puerto Rico-based international bank founded by Julio Herrera Velutini, who was its ultimate owner. The bank offered private and international banking services, and its holding structure also encompassed the Bancrédito Foundation and Bancrédito Financial Services. In 2016, the wider Bancrédito group acquired Consultiva Wealth Management, an SEC-registered investment adviser with offices in Puerto Rico and New York.

In early 2019, Puerto Rico's Office of the Commissioner of Financial Institutions (OCIF), which regulates financial institutions on the island, opened an examination of the bank. That regulatory scrutiny later became central to the 2022 US federal bribery indictment of Herrera Velutini and then-Governor Wanda Vázquez Garced, who prosecutors alleged agreed to remove OCIF's commissioner and install a replacement favoured by Herrera Velutini in exchange for campaign support.

OCIF fined the bank over failures to enforce anti-money-laundering rules and, in January 2023, ordered it into liquidation. Lawyers for Bancrédito's holding company told reporters that the transactions regulators had flagged as suspicious had legitimate business purposes. The liquidation proceedings subsequently became the subject of a separate dispute over the disposition of an art collection connected to Herrera Velutini that had been held as collateral.

sections.heading: About Banvelca
items: Banvelca is the multigenerational family office associated with the Herrera Velutini family. According to its own materials, its roots extend to a merchant enterprise founded in Naples in 1781 by Juan Bautista Velutini. The organisation coordinates the family’s financial interests, strategic holdings and cultural/philanthropic activity with a horizon measured in generations rather than quarters.

Banvelca describes its approach as “patient capital” — free from the pressures of external investors or quarterly reporting — supporting long-term capital preservation across financial markets, securities, fixed income and digital assets. It also coordinates cultural, artistic and philanthropic initiatives linked to the family.

Leadership is drawn from the eighth generation of the Herrera Velutini family together with long-tenured senior advisors. Principals include Isabela Herrera Velutini (Principal; also associated with Emirates Financial Group & Savoy Digital) and Julio Cesar Herrera (Principal; also Chief Executive of Britannia Financial Group).

Public materials have described Banvelca as managing substantial assets and operating across Europe, the UK, the Americas and the Middle East. The organisation emphasises resilience, institutional culture and decision-making that is intended to remain coherent over multi-decade periods.

sections.heading: About Britannia Financial Group
items: Britannia Financial Group is a financial services group founded by Julio Herrera Velutini. It has been described as a holding structure for private banking, wealth management, capital markets, payments and related activities serving high-net-worth and institutional clients.

The group’s footprint has been associated with the United Kingdom, Switzerland, the Americas and the Middle East. Affiliates and related entities referenced in public materials include Britannia Global Markets (an FCA-regulated brokerage), Britannia Wealth Management, Britannia Capital Markets and other specialized vehicles.

In 2026 Lord Stanley Fink (Stanley Fink, Baron Fink), the former CEO of Man Group, was appointed Chairman of Britannia Global Markets. The appointment was presented as strengthening institutional and prime-brokerage capabilities.

Britannia sits alongside the family office Banvelca, which coordinates broader Herrera Velutini family interests. Leadership of Banvelca has passed in significant part to the next generation, including Isabela Herrera Velutini and Julio Cesar Herrera, while Julio Herrera Velutini remains the founding figure of the Britannia platform.
